summary:
The Monkey D. Luffy on card number OP05-119 filed under the A Fist of Divine Speed 3rd Anniversary Gold Foil label belongs to a category collectors treat separately from ordinary parallels: the anniversary commemorative. Gold foil treatments are not simply a shinier version of an existing card. They are issued to mark a milestone in the game's life, which fixes them to a moment rather than to a print schedule, and that gives them a different demand profile from booster-pack chases. Attaching that treatment to Luffy - the character every new One Piece collector starts with - concentrates the anniversary premium onto the single most liquid name in the range.

### Basic Info
*   **Main subject / card theme:** Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates
*   **Set or product (catalog label):** 2025 A Fist of Divine Speed 3rd Anniversary Gold Foil
*   **Card number:** OP05-119
*   **Language version(s):** English catalog entry
*   **Rarity / treatment:** Gold foil anniversary commemorative
*   **Set label year:** 2025

### Community Pulse
Anniversary gold foils generate a distinctive kind of discussion. Because they are tied to a commemorative window rather than to an open-ended print run, collectors talk about them in terms of the occasion - what the third anniversary meant for a game that had grown faster than almost anyone expected - and that framing tends to keep them out of pure flip conversations. The technical thread is about the foil itself. Gold treatments show handling marks with unusual clarity: fingerprints, light scuffing and any dulling of the metallic field are visible under angled light in a way they simply are not on standard holo stock, so collectors are cautious about sleeving and about how many times a raw copy changes hands before grading. The other recurring topic is identification, because OP05-119 appears across several distinct printings and the anniversary gold foil has to be distinguished from the base and manga-art versions sharing that number.

### Card Fun Facts
*   Anniversary treatments are dated by nature - a third-anniversary card can only ever be a third-anniversary card, which is why collectors treat them as milestone pieces rather than interchangeable parallels.
*   Gold foil is one of the least forgiving finishes in modern card printing when it comes to surface inspection, making high grades scarcer relative to how carefully copies are handled.
*   The OP05-119 number is shared by multiple printings in this catalog, so the label is what separates this anniversary card from its siblings.

### Summary (TLDR)
This is the anniversary gold foil Luffy on card number OP05-119, filed under the 2025 A Fist of Divine Speed 3rd Anniversary Gold Foil label. It is collected as a milestone commemorative rather than as a booster chase, and its gold surface makes condition unusually visible - which is why identification and careful handling drive its market more than raw scarcity claims do.
